result.title: BO-Arena: An Evolving Benchmark for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimisation
result.summary: High-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (HDBO) is an increasingly crowded field with new methods proposed at every major conference, making it ever harder to answer a deceptively simple question: "Which method is currently state-of-the-art?" In this paper, we question the efficacy of benchmarking practices in the field, and find them to be systematically ineffective: multiple published works fail to benchmark against the strongest available baselines, or even include incorrect implementations of key methods. Without a shared reference implementation, such errors are difficult to detect during peer review. We therefore introduce BO-Arena, an actively maintained and extensible package providing canonical implementations of state-of-the-art algorithms, which allows researchers to develop new methods and benchmark them rigorously. Using BO-Arena, we find that what currently drives performance in HDBO is even simpler than previously thought. We use these insights to propose a new algorithm which is competitive with the state of the art on problems with many observations, without resorting to the complex GP approximations used in recent methods. Finally, we question whether there is currently sufficient evidence that any more complex method outperforms a simple Gaussian process baseline for HDBO.

AI.brief_summary: 论文质疑高维贝叶斯优化的评测实践，指出既有工作常漏掉强基线或误实现关键方法，据此提出可持续维护、含规范实现的 BO-Arena 基准包，并据其发现性能主要来自更简单的因素，进而给出无需复杂 GP 近似的新算法，同时追问复杂方法是否真的优于简单 GP 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属贝叶斯优化领域，但其采集函数驱动的序贯证据获取与停止决策，以及「复杂方法是否胜过简单基线、规范实现与严格基线」的评测质疑，或可启发 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 机制与 latent 方法评测严谨性的核查。
